inspections.title: Breathing / oxygen care problems
inspections.detail: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.

inspections.title: Unnecessary psychiatric drugs (sedating medications)

inspections.title: Care plan not updated on time
inspections.detail: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.detail: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

inspections.title: Pharmacist drug review not done properly
inspections.detail: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Resident choices not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to and the facility must promote and facilitate resident self-determination through support of resident choice.

inspections.title: Family or doctor not told about a change or injury
inspections.detail: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

inspections.title: Daily staffing not posted
inspections.detail: Post nurse staffing information every day.

inspections.title: Unclean or uncomfortable living space
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

inspections.title: Medications not labeled or stored correctly
inspections.detail: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

inspections.detail: Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.

inspections.title: Incontinence or catheter care problems
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
